issues.title: LO-18: HA shutdown() emits MQTT events without checking mqttConnected
issues.body:
Copied from https://github.com/JN0V/DomoticsCore/issues/172 for a trial of workline's line on this copy.

| LO-18 | HA | `shutdown()` emits MQTT events without checking `mqttConnected` — wasted EventBus traffic |

Opened from `docs/CODE-ROADMAP.md`, lines 6338 to 6338 by the product-owner role.

<!-- workline:import=docs/CODE-ROADMAP.md:d1e75279cdb8 -->

## Need

Draft: when the MQTT link is down, shutdown() should not queue events that cannot be delivered. They waste EventBus queue space.

## Verification

Extend test_ha_dropped_link: after an mqtt/disconnected event, call shutdown() and assert that no MQTT publish events are queued. Keep the connected case: shutdown() still emits the offline availability and the removals.

## Validation

Draft: the reporter (JN0V) reads the dropped-link test and accepts that shutdown stays quiet while disconnected.

## Scope

HomeAssistantComponent::shutdown(): the calls to setAvailable(false) and removeDiscovery() are made without checking mqttConnected
